segments.t: Hacia las nueve de la noche vuelve poco a poco la calma al patio mientras Hannah y Graham apilan las tazas blancas limpias en la habitación nueve y Evelyn cierra con suavidad la tapa de nogal del piano. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Not one chipped cup, zero blown fuses, and twenty-four happy neighbors.
You are smiling, Graham! I saw it clearly under the lamp!
Must be a trick of the frosted glass, Hannah.
Hannah, before you close the big paper reservation book tonight...
Is everything all right in Room Four, Miss Evelyn? Did the buzzer ring twice again?
I have grown quite fond of that double ring. Is Room Four free next week?
Wait, you want to extend your stay with us, Miss Evelyn?!
Two more weeks, if you will have me, and I will play every Friday for tea!
Room Four belongs to you as long as you want it, ma'am.
Written in pencil right here! Tessa and Arthur will be thrilled!
Oh, by the way, the mailman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate box.
Evening mail on a Friday? Let us take it to the front desk!
Repasemos cada réplica de este tranquilo final de velada.
Not one chipped cup, zero blown fuses, and twenty-four happy neighbors.
'Ni una taza desportillada, cero fusibles fundidos y veinticuatro vecinos felices.'
You are smiling, Graham! I saw it clearly under the lamp!
'¡Estás sonriendo, Graham! ¡Lo vi claramente bajo la lámpara!'
Must be a trick of the frosted glass, Hannah.
'Debe de ser un efecto del cristal esmerilado, Hannah.'
Hannah, before you close the big paper reservation book tonight...
'Hannah, antes de que cierres el gran libro de reservas de papel esta noche...'
Is everything all right in Room Four, Miss Evelyn? Did the buzzer ring twice again?
'¿Está todo bien en la habitación cuatro, señorita Evelyn? ¿Volvió a sonar dos veces el timbre?'
I have grown quite fond of that double ring. Is Room Four free next week?
'Le he tomado bastante cariño a ese doble timbre. ¿Está libre la habitación cuatro la semana que viene?'
Wait, you want to extend your stay with us, Miss Evelyn?!
'Espera, ¿¡quiere prolongar su estancia con nosotros, señorita Evelyn!?'
Two more weeks, if you will have me, and I will play every Friday for tea!
'¡Dos semanas más, si me aceptan, y tocaré todos los viernes para el té!'
Room Four belongs to you as long as you want it, ma'am.
'La habitación cuatro le pertenece todo el tiempo que la quiera, señora.'
Written in pencil right here! Tessa and Arthur will be thrilled!
'¡Anotado a lápiz justo aquí! ¡Tessa y Arthur van a estar encantados!'
Oh, by the way, the mailman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate box.
'Ah, por cierto, el cartero deslizó una postal extranjera gruesa en el buzón del portón.'
Evening mail on a Friday? Let us take it to the front desk!
'¿Correo vespertino en viernes? ¡Llevémoslo a la recepción!'
Escuchemos de nuevo toda la escena con fluidez.
Not one chipped cup, zero blown fuses, and twenty-four happy neighbors.
You are smiling, Graham! I saw it clearly under the lamp!
Must be a trick of the frosted glass, Hannah.
Hannah, before you close the big paper reservation book tonight...

I have grown quite fond of that double ring. Is Room Four free next week?
Wait, you want to extend your stay with us, Miss Evelyn?!
Two more weeks, if you will have me, and I will play every Friday for tea!
Room Four belongs to you as long as you want it, ma'am.
Written in pencil right here! Tessa and Arthur will be thrilled!
Oh, by the way, the mailman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate box.
Evening mail on a Friday? Let us take it to the front desk!
¡Evelyn se queda como pianista de los viernes y una misteriosa postal aguarda en el buzón del portón! Nos vemos en la próxima escena.
See you soon!
